written.headline: Google launches Gemini Decisions API for fast multimodal yes/no and choice scoring
written.summary: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by the Gemini Decision 1 model, allowing up to 1,000 bounded-choice questions per request across text, images, audio, video and PDFs. The service costs $0.10 per million input tokens and returns probabilities in 150‑250 ms.
